metadata.case_name: CHAN YUEN KUEN AND OTHERS v. CHAN KWOK CHU AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: she had a fracture of the left humerus.
source: she had a fracture of the left humerus.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of shoulder or upper arm, unspecified

injuries.description: the Plaintiff's left arm is permanently bent at the elbow
source: In practical terms this means that the Plaintiff's left arm is permanently bent at the elbow and her left hand is extremely weak. The condition will not improve.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple nerves at forearm level

injuries.description: her left hand is extremely weak
source: In practical terms this means that the Plaintiff's left arm is permanently bent at the elbow and her left hand is extremely weak. The condition will not improve.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified nerve at wrist or hand level

manifestations.description: The Board found residual pain at her left elbow
Supination was full but pronation limited to 40°
The range of flexion at her left elbow was limited from 80° to 120°
Weakness of her left wrist was also detected in both flexion and extension movements
whereas her right hand exercised a 30lb grip her left could only manage 3 lb
she is afraid of corssing road
she cannot do up her own buttons
she cannot engage in the normal schoolgirl sports and pastimes
she has ... the sense of isolation from her friends in their play and sporting activities

treatments_received: traction (displacement failed to be corrected by traction)
transferred to Sandy Bay Hospital and operated on
arm remained in plaster for two months

losses.description: left hand is extremely weak / very little use from her left hand; weak grip (left could only manage 3 lb)
